why_it_matters.text: An anticonvulsant sold as Keppra, one of the most widely used seizure medicines. It binds SV2A, a protein on the tiny sacs that release nerve signals.

approval.basis: Marketed today (prescription) under NDA 021035 in the Drugs@FDA data files.
